resolved_conflict.title: Postel's Law (Lenience) vs Secure APIs (Strict Validation)
resolved_conflict.principle_a: Be liberal in what you accept: tolerate varied inputs, strip whitespace, coerce formats to provide seamless UX.
resolved_conflict.principle_b: Strict schema validation: reject any unrecognized parameters, strip extraneous fields, prevent injection.
resolved_conflict.resolution: LAYERED CONTEXTUAL RESOLUTION: Postel's Law applies exclusively at the Frontend UI Client layer (e.g. forgiving date formats, trimming leading spaces). Secure APIs Strict Validation applies categorically at the Backend API Gateway / Controller boundary (Zod strict mode, rejecting unknown body parameters). The API boundary must never be lenient.
